description: HV-7.3 operational metrics tracked before and after the harness validation program

first_pass_conformance_rate.definition: Fraction of runs that pass validation on first attempt

correction_success_rate.definition: Fraction of correction attempts that achieve conformance

agent_completed_nonconforming_rate.definition: Fraction of runs where Hermes succeeded but validation failed

confirmed_false_rejection_rate.definition: Fraction of old-failed runs that new policy would pass

complete_phase_reruns_avoided.definition: Count of reruns avoided by correction

median_time_output_to_publication.definition: Wall-clock from role closure to publication (seconds)
